name: @lrd/capture
description: M1 capture rig: stubhouse (local HTTP stand-ins for the GoHighLevel/Slack/Google Sheets response shapes @lrd/engine already defines) plus capture.mjs, which imports content/workflow.json into a local n8n, points its integration nodes at stubhouse, fires the webhook with the fictional Radiant Aesthetics lead, waits for the real execution to finish, and emits run.json + execution.json + attest.json into content/runs/<id>/. See README.md for exactly how the redirection works and why.
